messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Refill too soon: last fill 2025-02-20 with 30-day supply; only 18 days elapsed by 2025-03-10 (<22.5 required).", "verifier": {"reason": "At least 75% of the `days_supply` must have elapsed since the `last_fill_date` (e.g., for a 30-day supply, at least 22.5 days must have passed). — Only 18 days have elapsed since the last fill, but 22.5 days are required for a 30-day supply. The refill-too-soon rule is violated."}}
